description:
Part 3 of 3: Final Clean Up.
Links:
 Part 1: End Prep and Adapter Ligation
 Part 2: Clean Up and PCR Enrichment
* Part 3: Final Clean Up
With this protocol, your robot can perform a modified Quarter Volume NEBNext Ultra II FS DNA Library Prep Kit for Illumina protocol described by the Experimental Protocol. NEB Instruction Manual for NEBNext.
This is part 3 of the protocol: Final Clean Up.
This protocol assumes up to 96 input samples and follows the attached experimental protocol.

workflow.text: Set up for part 3: Remove used tip boxes.
Move PCR plate to magnetic module. Reagent reservoir in deck slot 1,
p20 tips in slots 2 and 3, p300 tips in slots 5, 6 and 9.
slow flow rate for aspiration and dispense
wait for liquid to finish moving after aspiration and dispense
